style: instrumental video game background music, seamless 2 minute loop, designed to repeat for hours without fatiguing. The main in-game screen of a startup survival game: a founder working late in a cozy garage office, week after week — focused 2am energy that still believes in itself. Mood: warm, calm, quietly determined. Half-time head-nod groove: whisper-quiet brushed drums, round soft upright bass, sparse intimate felt piano chords with real silence between phrases, a soft repeating marimba pattern, and a very subtle synth pulse underneath. Only occasionally, a distant soft muted trumpet hums a slowed two-bar fragment of a melody, then disappears again — at least a third of the loop is groove only, no melody at all, so the ear never wears out. Minimal, unobtrusive, modern small-room production, dry and close, humanized timing; supports reading without demanding attention. 96 BPM, F major. No vocals, no busy soloing, no intro, no outro, no fade-out.
